import csv
import io


def write_rows(rows, fieldnames):
    output = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(output, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction="ignore")
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return output.getvalue()
